correctness.rationale: Unitary dilation reduces the question to a unit-spaced Zak multiplier. Direct independent geometric-tail summation gives F=2(|E|^2+|O|^2). Explicit nonnegative coefficients prove strict monotonicity in cos(2theta), locating angular extrema. The upper fiber is a strictly convex positive exponential polynomial with equal endpoints; the lower fiber derivative has exactly one positive quadratic root between equal endpoints. Simultaneous vanishing of the two parity contributions would force \(rs=1\), excluded by positive rates. Finite standalone checks (12,431 assertions, deterministic) corroborate the complete analytic proof but do not replace it. The proof separately determines the normalization factor hc^2.

value.rationale: A two-independent-rate family of continuous totally positive Gabor windows is a canonical asymmetric generalization of the even exponential. Existence of frames at density two was known but does not quantify reconstruction stability. The result classifies both exact optimal spectral endpoints on the entire positive parameter quadrant, gives a novel radical formula and a unique interior worst-fiber location, and permits exact condition-number computations for every skew ratio. This is a natural full classification rather than an arbitrary computed finite slice. No claims about new frame-set existence, symmetric case priority, or other redundancies.
